grammar: typescript
asserts: values, tql_tree, source_tree, bytecode

--- tql ---
. / class_declaration as @c |
@c.name as @class_name |
select(@class_name | text ~ /Foo.*/ and any(@c.body / method_definition; .return_type != null)) |
{ @class_name }

--- source ---
class Foo1 {
  m1(): string {}
  m2() {}
  m3(): number {}
}

class Foo2 {}

class Foo3 {
  m3() {}
}

--- values ---
[
  {
    "class_name": {
      "kind": "type_identifier",
      "text": "Foo1",
      "start_byte": 6,
      "end_byte": 10,
      "start_point": {
        "row": 0,
        "column": 6
      },
      "end_point": {
        "row": 0,
        "column": 10
      }
    }
  }
]

--- tql tree ---
(source_file (pipe (pipe (bind (pipe (bind (child . (node class_declaration)) c) (field c name)) class_name) (call select (and (regex_match (pipe class_name (call text)) (regex "Foo.*")) (call any (child (field c body) (node method_definition)) (ne (dot-field return_type) null))))) (object class_name)))
